checks.detail: Fresh candidate review reached title, gameplay, combat, draft, pause and diagnostic boss states; full release acceptance remains blocked by incomplete ordinary route and unavailable native dense qualification.

Ordinary W movement changed the Warden position and Space advanced dash_cycle_count to 1 with recovery state; pause ownership transitioned cleanly. Complete landmark-side collision and camera-relative coverage were not established.

AttackRuntime recorded 7 authorized and 7 completed lantern attacks, 7 hits, deterministic focused_once_per_attack receipts, one reward drop, and no rejection receipt; candidate logs were clean. Audible waveform causality was not established.

Live actors showed approach, waiting_admission, hurt/recovery, target validity, pooled generations, vitality bars and active cap; all archetype lifecycle, separation, death/drop and pool-return cells were not observed in ordinary play.

A paused three-card draft rendered truthful current/new deltas and focus state; ui_accept applied Warden Lantern rank 2 damage 34/range 13 before active play resumed, while a committed drop existed at death position. XP interpolation, overflow preservation and attraction/collection feedback were not fully observed. coverage.baseline.survivor_reward_feedback.f3a12bf95b42=insufficient_evidence;

Gameplay, pause and upgrade screenshots showed compact authored iconography, readable health/XP/wave/boss fields, three silhouette-led cards and full-viewport pause/draft composition; native/fullscreen/settings-scale persistence and repeated ordinary-enemy vitality retirement were not fully covered. coverage.baseline.survivor_onboarding_input_guida.aeacca15e82a=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.survivor_enemy_vitality.2e8fe7fe7b3c=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.survivor_choice_visual_hierarch.c96a93673ada=pass;
Fresh run serial 1 booted cleanly and pause ownership was single-shot, but three complete retry cycles, failure/result and replay baseline were not observed.

Candidate identity, project path, source hash, MCP project info, runtime digests, editor/runtime logs, scene spatial data, camera coverage, custom diagnostic views and mesh validation were collected against the exact candidate.

Inventory preserved distinct focused_bolt, threat_sweep and persistent_orbit strategies and the first ordinary upgrade changed focused-bolt damage/range; only lantern was exercised and no complete sweep/orbit paths were observed.

Ordinary play reached wave 2 with contiguous progress, while a diagnostic branch reached Bellkeeper wave 5 phase 1 entrance with boss_request_count 1 and bell_wave telegraph. Ordinary five-wave completion, both phases, recovery, defeat and Result remain unverified. coverage.baseline.closure_candidate.8df225314610=insufficient_evidence;

The intact authored package loaded with 92 visual nodes and runtime bounds; fresh camera coverage classified the keeper post, mausoleum and cracked bell anchors visible, but the correction-specific ordinary-input perimeter, four-cardinal, collision-side and before/near/after receipts remain unavailable because the live branch was paused in boss context. coverage.baseline.survivor_external_world_continu.a67126c290ec=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.survivor_landmark_collision_int.1241aa6fe55c=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.survivor_arena_spatial_integrit.150a2175f98f=insufficient_evidence;

Runtime states exposed Idle, Spellcast_Shoot, hurt/recovery, dash recovery, bounded presentation pools and loaded semantic audio resources; the independent Master/Effects capture was fully silent with no source events after a timed-out step, so audible causal acceptance and dense audiovisual masking remain unverified.

Title, gameplay HUD, upgrade and pause pages were captured with authored icons, focus states and full-viewport composition; settings persistence, credits, result, gamepad traversal and clean title/replay flow were not exercised.

Changed dense_profile.gd records native 1920x1080, 25-40 enemy, three-cycle, renderer-gated receipts and sampling-independent preflight; live runtime classified Mesa llvmpipe and profile_status rejected_software_renderer, so native frame-time qualification is unavailable.

Title-to-gameplay, automatic attacks, drop, draft, selected upgrade, dash, pause and diagnostic Bellkeeper entrance were observed, but the complete ordinary five-wave victory/failure-to-result run, three viable builds, credits/provenance and replay were not established.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime evidence against the PRD requirements for phase release_convergence.

Use ordinary keyboard and gamepad-equivalent input to verify camera-relative planar movement, collision sliding, visual facing, dash anticipation/invulnerability/recovery/cooldown, high-angle camera framing and clean pause/resume. Judge only behavior introduced by the active phase; reject hidden threats, contradictory velocity, stuck input or camera modes that drift toward FPS/TPS play.

Bind one stable event chain from cooldown and deterministic legal target selection through emitted attack, hit policy, damage, hurt, exactly-once death and drop. Require visible and audible anticipation, onset, impact and recovery without manual-fire drift, duplicate damage, freed targets, inert attacks or presentation disconnected from state.

Exercise active enemy roles from validated off-camera spawn through approach, separation, telegraph, attack, hurt, death, drop and pool return. Reject collision or out-of-bounds spawns, root sliding, static poses, first-frame damage, unreadable overlap, dead actors moving, permanent clumps, blocked escape lanes and stale pooled state.

Verify enemy reward, collection, experience threshold and overflow, one paused three-choice draft, debounced selection, authoritative build mutation and resumed play with an observable changed attack or utility. Reject duplicate drafts, held-confirm double choice, blank/inert cards, false values, lost overflow or gameplay clocks advancing under draft.

Require every introduced health, experience, level, wave/run, weapon, dash and boss field to match authoritative runtime state while leaving the arena readable. Judge native, fullscreen and supported UI scales; reject default fonts, debug labels, text piles, opaque blue/purple blocks, generic rounded cards, clipped controls and top-left-only pages.

From title through gameplay, pause, player failure and retry, verify single authoritative run transitions and a clean baseline after three restarts. Reject stale actors, timers, signals, pools, pause reasons, input ownership, attacks, effects or audio, and any state that requires restarting the application to recover.

Bind black-box ordinary play and white-box authoritative snapshots, events, transforms, animation/audio owners, logs and distributed frames to the exact candidate. Deterministic setup may reach legal branches, but normal runtime systems and input must cause the accepted outcome.

Exercise every weapon and representative upgrade path. Require focused bolts, close sweep and orbiting area control to retain distinct targeting, cadence, geometry, hit policy, feedback and build consequences rather than renamed copies of one projectile.

Verify five data-driven wave states, composition escalation, elite pressure and the Bellkeeper's two phases, telegraphs, summons or lane pressure, recovery window, exactly-once defeat and victory. The director must honor live caps and stop after terminal state.

Compare ordinary runtime views with the frozen Mournlight visual reference. Require one coherent bounded cemetery, grounded collision, keeper post, mausoleum and cracked bell landmarks, clear escape lanes, readable silhouettes, coherent scale/materials and no visible stand-ins.

Inspect accepted component/source values and every active animation state, moonlight/lantern hierarchy, causal bounded VFX and semantic audio layer under real crowd density. Reject unrelated fallback clips, sliding/dead movement, overdark or clipped light, leaked loops, hum, unexpected speech, generic tones and effects that hide telegraphs.

Navigate title, settings, upgrade, pause, death, victory and result pages across the full viewport with mouse, keyboard and gamepad focus. Verify persisted audio/window/UI-scale/effect settings, authored iconography and typography, truthful summaries and clean replay/title flow.

Profile the representative final wave and boss at 1920x1080 with 25-40 ordinary enemies, all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI and audio. Require stable frame-time distribution, bounded high-churn work and no growth across three complete retries.

Play the complete seven-to-ten-minute title-to-result run, including failure and victory branches, three viable build shapes, statistics, credits/provenance and replay. Reject placeholders, debug presentation, missing required content or unresolved release-relevant regressions.
